verdict.summary: Round 2 confirms the prior approval. The verifier now collects every distinct slot occupied by the filtered variable across all query patterns matched by a scan and requires a matching true filter edge for every active row and slot. The BTreeSet deduplicates same-slot matches without weakening the obligation. The negative regression test reaches the real structural verifier and specifically witnesses the pre-fix find_map acceptance gap; the positive test validates same-slot deduplication. The audit update accurately limits the demonstrated impact to structural-gate reachability and retains the external-audit caveat. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue was found.
